About the Project

The Selim Heights is a residential development in Mather Kona, South Keraniganj. Its three towers offer layouts with separate living and dining areas, a kitchen and a staff room. The plans include a children’s activity area and a rooftop terrace with space to sit outside or get together.

First Floor

See the apartment layouts and shared lift and stair access across the three towers.

Ground Floor

The ground floor includes parking, a building management office and a 1,267 sq ft children’s play and activity area. The plan also includes a security control room and a separate waiting room and toilet for drivers.

Basement

The basement plan shows space for car and motorcycle parking, with a ramp for vehicle access.

Roof

The roof plan includes a swimming pool, a 1,656 sq ft community space, landscaped areas and a barbecue area.

Features and Amenities

  • Rooftop swimming pool
  • Landscaped rooftop and barbecue area
  • Rooftop community space
  • Children’s play and activity area
  • Car and motorcycle parking
  • Passenger lifts and backup generator
  • CCTV in shared areas and an intercom to each apartment
  • Building management office and drivers’ waiting room

Building Specifications

The main materials and fittings used in the building.

Download Brochure
Structure

The brochure specifies machine-made concrete blocks or solid bricks for the walls and laboratory testing of construction materials.

Floors and Walls

Polished tiles in the main rooms, non-slip tiles on the kitchen veranda, and smooth paint on interior walls and ceilings.

Doors and Windows

Solid teak main door with a fingerprint lock, glass sliding doors and windows, and window security grilles. Bathroom doors are made from wood-plastic composite.

Kitchen

Granite countertop, tiled walls and floors, a double-bowl sink, and hot and cold water lines. The plans specify an LPG connection with a leak detector.

Bathrooms

Wall and floor tiles, mirrors, and concealed hot and cold water lines. The main and second bathrooms have cabinet basins with marble countertops.

Electrical and Plumbing

Power points for air conditioning in bedrooms and living and dining areas, plus concealed TV and internet connections. The water supply includes an underground reservoir and an overhead tank.
